# Security policy

Security fixes are provided for the latest released DocWen version.

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** action on the repository Security page when private
vulnerability reporting is available. If it is unavailable, open a public issue containing only a
request for private contact. Do not include exploit details, credentials, private document content,
document paths, diagnostic archives, or unsanitized logs in a public issue.

Include the DocWen version, operating system, affected command or workflow, impact, and the smallest
safe reproduction you can provide. Ordinary bugs and feature requests belong in the issue forms.
